name: utas/mobile-friendly-classroom-allocation
description: Mobile-friendly classroom allocation and timetable management system

suggest.ext-gmp: Enables true 64-bit arithmetic in the allocation RNG. Not required: the engine's 31-bit generator is sufficient, see src/Domain/Allocation/Rng.php.

scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Allocation engine suite — pure PHP, no database required
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Repository and service suite — needs a migrated database
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Static analysis (level 6) over src/, tests/, bin/, config/, public/
scripts-descriptions.lint: Code style against phpcs.xml (PSR-12 + project rules)
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs, in the order that fails fastest
scripts-descriptions.golden: Regenerate the golden baseline and re-check the accuracy gate
scripts-descriptions.bench: Time the engine on the reference dataset
scripts-descriptions.serve: PHP's built-in web server on the public/ document root
